questions.q: What is the mass of 0.200 mol of magnesium chloride, MgCl₂? (Ar: Mg = 24, Cl = 35.5)
What volume does 0.88 g of carbon dioxide occupy at r.t.p.? (Mr CO₂ = 44; molar gas volume 24 dm³)
How many molecules are in 9.0 g of water? (Mr H₂O = 18; Avogadro constant 6.02 × 10²³)
CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂. Calculate the mass of calcium oxide formed when 25 g of calcium carbonate is heated. (Ar: Ca = 40, C = 12, O = 16)
questions.model: n(CaCO₃) = 25 ÷ 100 = 0.25 mol; 1 : 1 ratio so n(CaO) = 0.25 mol; mass = 0.25 × 56 = 14 g
